items.title: Costco (COST) Declares $30 Special Dividend And Reauthorizes $4 Billion Buyback
items.summary: Costco Wholesale (NasdaqGS:COST) declared a special cash dividend of $30 per share on common stock. The retailer also reauthorized a $4b share repurchase program with an expiration date in January 2030. The one time $30 special dividend and long dated buyback plan matter, but they are only part of the Costco picture. Our analysis turns up 1 warning sign for Costco Wholesale as well. items.title: Costco Just Sent Shareholders a $13 Billion Signal It Has More Cash Than It Can Use. Here’s What 200 Shares Collect
items.summary: Costco declared a $30 a share special cash dividend after Tuesday's close, about $13.3 billion in all and the largest in its history, payable December 4 to holders of record November 24, plus a new $4 billion buyback. For a retired couple with 200 shares bought in 2010 that is a $6,000 check: here is the tax on it in a brokerage account, an IRA and a Roth, what the stock does on the ex-date, and the one decision the check forces.
